# Anim ids

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/anim-ids.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The 722 anim ids every character data maps to clips. A character's own slot wins; an unset slot
plays the generic character data's clip ([Characters](../research/characters.md#files)). Scripts name ids
with the `ANIM_*` constants of `royal.lua`; the locomotion slots are
[Characters, Anim slots](../research/characters.md#anim-slots).

!!! info "What is complete"

    All 722 ids are listed with the generic clip and Rembrandt's own clip where he has one. Names
    exist only for the ids `royal.lua` defines.

722 entries. Data: `research/references/anim-ids.yaml`.

## Sources and evidence

Evidence levels used: inferred.

- royal.lua (names); character data (clips); 0x005105d8 (slots)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | int | | Anim id (0-721): an index into every character data's anim table. |
| `name` | str | | The `ANIM_*` name the scripts give the id. |
| `slot` | int | | Locomotion slot (0-34) that holds this id by default. |
| `generic` | str | | The clip the generic character data plays for it (`generic_header`). |
| `rembrandt` | str | | The clip Rembrandt's character data plays for it (`warr_re_header`). |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
